items.text: Nicole La Ha was selected as the 82nd District state representative in December 2023 and previously served as a Homer Glen village trustee. She was the Illinois Senate press secretary and co-founded the Ability Awareness Committee in Homer Glen. Her campaign says she has worked to lower costs, end the grocery tax, improve early childhood education, and expand mental healthcare. She has called for lower property taxes, stating that Illinois homeowners pay roughly double the national average.

items.text: She sponsored a law encouraging accessibility in park projects funded by OSLAD grants. In the legislature, she sponsored laws regarding human trafficking signs and DNA profiles. She also sponsored laws concerning special education transition services and homeless youth funding.
